question: Is the following claim true? Alan Turing's paper 'On Computable Numbers' was published in 1946.
source: author-written for this project; verified by the author

claims.text: Turing wrote the design report for the ACE at the National Physical Laboratory around 1946.
Turing's ideas about computation were widely discussed in the 1946 period.
A 1946 date for the paper sounds plausible and could be confused with his postwar work.
'On Computable Numbers' was received by the London Mathematical Society in 1936.
The paper was published in the Proceedings of the London Mathematical Society in 1937.
The paper appeared in two parts, in the 1936 and 1937 issues.
The paper predates the 1946 ACE report by about a decade.
The publication record decides the question, and the paper was not published in 1946.
The 1946 association comes from Turing's later work, not from this paper.
The claim that the paper was published in 1946 is false.
